annotations.title: Get a link to make a call

description: Places nothing. Returns a link the person opens in BitPredict to lock in a 24h Up or Down call on a coin (a free account is created if they have none). Use it when the person wants to make that call.

direction.description: Whether the coin finishes the 24 hours higher (up) or lower (down).

symbol.description: Coin ticker such as BTC, ETH or SOL. A coin name such as "Bitcoin" also works.

name: make_call

placed.description: Always false: nothing is placed until the person opens the link.

url.description: Link the person opens to lock the call in.

title: Get a link to make a call
